capabilities: Resolve [[alias]] links, hover previews, embeds, and backlinks to the page holding the alias
Delete empty pages whose names are aliases of another page
List alias conflicts where a name points to multiple pages
Configure per-page case-sensitive alias matching via a property
disambiguation: Not a Logseq integration or importer; it only changes how alias links resolve inside Obsidian.
extras: Install is manual (copy main.js and manifest.json) or via BRAT; the listing notes it has not been manually reviewed by Obsidian staff. Redirection only works where the plugin is installed; tools reading Markdown files directly still see unresolved links.
intentEvidence: makes [[alias]] links open the page that has the alias, the way Logseq does
motivation: The author wanted Logseq's behavior, where an alias and the page name are the same thing, brought to Obsidian.
problem: Obsidian only uses aliases for link suggestions, so a manually typed [[alias]] stays unresolved and clicking it creates an empty page that then captures all future links.

relations.evidence: open the page that has the alias, the way Logseq does
other plugins that use the same API (Dataview, backlink plugins)

summary: Alias link resolver that makes [[alias]] links open the page holding that alias, Logseq-style, instead of creating empty unresolved pages.
